title: Catastrophic Overfitting, Entropy Gap and Participation Ratio: A Noiseless $l^p$ Norm Solution for Fast Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2505.02360v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adversarial training is a cornerstone of robust deep learning, but fast methods like the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) often suffer from Catastrophic Overfitting (CO), where models become robust to single-step attacks but fail against multi-step variants. While existing solutions rely on noise injection, regularization, or gradient clipping, we propose a novel solution that purely controls the $l^p$ training norm to mitigate CO. Our study is motivated by the empirical observation that CO is more prevalent under the $l^{\infty}$ norm than the $l^2$ norm. Leveraging this insight, we develop a framework for generalized $l^p$ attack as a fixed point problem and craft $l^p$-FGSM attacks to understand the transition mechanics from $l^2$ to $l^{\infty}$. This leads to our core insight: CO emerges when highly concentrated gradients, where information localizes in few dimensions, interact with aggressive norm constraints. By quantify

translated_title: 灾难性过拟合、熵差距与参与率：用于快速对抗训练的无噪声 $l^p$ 范数解决方案
translated_abstract: 对抗训练是鲁棒深度学习的基石，但快速梯度符号法（FGSM）等快速方法常常遭受灾难性过拟合（CO）的困扰，即模型对单步攻击具有鲁棒性，但在面对多步攻击变体时会失效。虽然现有解决方案依赖于噪声注入、正则化或梯度裁剪，我们提出了一种新颖的解决方案，纯粹通过控制 $l^p$ 训练范数来缓解CO。我们的研究源于一个实证观察：CO在 $l^{\infty}$ 范数下比在 $l^2$ 范数下更为普遍。利用这一洞察，我们开发了一个将广义 $l^p$ 攻击建模为不动点问题的框架，并设计了 $l^p$-FGSM 攻击以理解从 $l^2$ 到 $l^{\infty}$ 的转换机制。由此得出我们的核心洞察：当高度集中的梯度（即信息局限于少数维度）与激进的范数约束相互作用时，CO就会出现。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种纯粹通过控制 $l^p$ 训练范数来缓解快速对抗训练中灾难性过拟合的无噪声新方案，并揭示灾难性过拟合源于高度集中的梯度与激进范数约束的相互作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a noiseless solution to mitigate catastrophic overfitting in fast adversarial training purely by controlling the $l^p$ training norm, revealing that catastrophic overfitting arises when highly concentrated gradients interact with aggressive norm constraints.
